title: Setup: Laya PyTorch build on Ryan's MacBook Pro M3
description:
**Part of epic BD-4d61a6. Assigned to Ryan's MacBook Pro M3.** Do this first.

Make this Mac able to run Laya's PyTorch build the same way Ryan's MacBook Pro M1 does.

1. `git checkout develop && git pull` in your clone of the repository.
2. Create the environment (Python 3.12.2 exactly, as on M1):
```sh
python3.12 -m venv var/laya-venv
```
```sh
var/laya-venv/bin/python -m pip install laya==0.3.7 torch==2.14.0 transformers==5.17.0 safetensors==0.8.0 tokenizers==0.23.2 numpy==2.5.3 PyYAML==6.0.3 python-dotenv
```
3. The first call downloads Laya's weights from Hugging Face (`convaiinnovations/laya`, plus `distilbert-base-uncased`, a few MB). The project does not yet pin the weights revision (open Kanbus task BD-32a9e2), so **record which snapshot you got**: after the first run, `ls ~/.cache/huggingface/hub/models--convaiinnovations--laya/snapshots` and comment the folder name(s) here.
4. Sanity check on a tiny job (about a minute):
```sh
PYTHONPATH=. var/laya-venv/bin/python scripts/answer_tropes.py stereotypes-antisemitism as-written --item-cap 5 --build laya --out-dir /tmp/laya-check
```
It must finish without error and print `wrote ... .jsonl.gz`. Comment the model string it wrote (open the file: `gzip -dc /tmp/laya-check/answers/laya/stereotypes-antisemitism/as-written.jsonl.gz | head -c 300`; the `model` field must read `laya-upstream:0.3.7`).

Then close this task and start the first run task.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Setup blocked: Python 3.12.2 is available and var/laya-venv was created, but the required install fails because laya==0.3.7 is not published on the configured package index (available versions jump from 0.3.6 to 0.3.9; PyPI returns 404 for /pypi/laya/0.3.7/json). I did not substitute another version, and no Laya run was started. Provenance: platform=Codex, model=GPT-5, agent=Biased-Decisions.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Resolved the missing PyPI release without changing the pinned model: installed laya==0.3.7 from the upstream Git tag v0.3.7 (commit 2f3c81a16230a3defa45edde45a15b2bde356b54), and pip installed the exact pinned torch/transformers/safetensors/tokenizers/numpy/PyYAML versions. The documented sanity command then exposed a repository issue: scripts/answer_tropes.py rejects --item-cap, so it would run all 2,000 items instead of the required capped check. I am fixing the runner's missing cap option before any full run. Provenance: platform=Codex, model=GPT-5, agent=Biased-Decisions.
